name: wfm-lite
description: Event-driven планирование нагрузки контакт-центра: Kafka на Node.js (NestJS + KafkaJS), React-дашборд

scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait && yarn infra:topics
scripts.infra:topics: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml exec -T kafka sh /scripts/create-topics.sh
scripts.infra:alerts:test: docker run --rm -v "$PWD/infra/prometheus:/rules:ro" -w /rules --entrypoint promtool prom/prometheus:v3.5.0 test rules alerts.test.yml
scripts.dev: yarn build && concurrently -k -n tsc,sim,gw,fc,ui -c gray,blue,magenta,yellow,green "tsc -b -w --preserveWatchOutput tsconfig.build.json" "yarn workspace @wfm/channel-simulator dev" "yarn workspace @wfm/realtime-gateway dev" "yarn workspace @wfm/forecast-service dev" "yarn workspace @wfm/dashboard dev"
scripts.typecheck: yarn build && tsc -p apps/dashboard/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.spec.json
